item.text: The exporter stops when a page has fewer active records than requested, but deleted records still occupy page slots. I’ll make it stop only when the gateway returns a null continuation cursor. Project exports use a larger page size, which hides this bug in the three-record example.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. Pagination now follows the gateway’s continuation cursor until null, so deleted records cannot prematurely end an export.

The reported example now exports both `i-1` and `i-3`. Added regression coverage for deleted records, empty pages, and empty bookmarks. All 4 tests pass.
